originality.rationale: Prékopa (1972), Section 5 and Lemma 2, proves the constant for area-uniform interior simplex points, equivalently equal mass on each edge under radial projection. The new probability under uniform total boundary arclength assigns unequal edge masses proportional to unequal Euclidean side lengths; the exact cubic and strict majorization shape law do not appear in that primary statement and are not covered by symmetry-based Wendel or the interior-volume moment literature. Primary source scans were inspected. The numeric equilateral specialization is expressly known and is not claimed novel; residual possible unindexed weighted-boundary formula remains.
residual_risks: Halász–Kleitman 1974 specialist original full text was not available for materially complete inspection; available abstract refers to area-uniform samples.
An older generalized boundary-direction or conditional-integration theorem may algebraically subsume the weighted boundary formula even though current searches did not locate one.
The sharp numerical upper endpoint is a known Prékopa value and must not be represented as newly computed novelty.
